title: Ivan
desc: Jeevan wants to fight against the injustice in society. After losing his father to anti-social elements and knowing that he cannot fight alone, he approaches the cause differently.

title: Mahesh Babu No.1
desc: A rock star is convinced that his parents were murdered by three men. Taking the support of a journalist, he sets out to find the culprits.

title: Maya
desc: Apsara, a single mother, ends up watching a scary film for a contest. However, things take a horrifying turn when a ghost begins to haunt her.

title: Ragasiya Police
desc: Surya, a police officer, is removed from a case when he is on the verge of tracing the culprit. However, when it is handed to his friend and he gets killed, Surya sets out to catch the killer.

title: Gajini
desc: A medical student gets invested in the story of the former business mogul who is reported to have anterograde amnesia. However, her curiosity leads to dangerous answers that she is not ready to face.
